game-master.viewingScope: Decoded contact sheets over the acquired ranges plus denser selected scene samples viewed directly by agent. Native files remain unmodified; no audio track was acquired.
game-master.audioExclusionReason: Video-only source; third-party soundtrack and voices not adopted.
game-master.observedBeforeActionResult: Outside ocean waves are high; selected brief wide cabin views show floorboards. Dense exact-frame review found that local130–137 is predominantly a wall-repair closeup, so it is no longer adopted as a sustained floor view. No measured interior/exterior water-height comparison is adopted.
game-master.claimLimits: Source establishes visible outside ocean and interior floor only. Separate flooding/masking implementation comes from original developer source and our native Unity demonstration, not measured gameplay water levels.

inspectedIntervalsOriginalSeconds.role: Large ocean waves around ship exterior.
Player descends below deck, shallow interior water and leaking hull shown; repair closes hole.
Return to deck and high surrounding ocean after repair.

openingCutCorrection.method: Direct view of exact decoded1920x1080 frames at0.1–0.2s spacing around the interior camera turn, plus whole-source contact and exact exterior samples. This is bounded sample review, not full realtime playback.
openingCutCorrection.firstCutEndRule: First exterior cut ends at p1-1b even when less than six seconds.
openingCutCorrection.remainingOpening: Existing Unity stage1, explicitly self-authored explanation, continues the thesis after the brief actual floor evidence. Short floor footage is not lengthened or padded with the rejected repair closeup.
openingCutCorrection.excluded: Original radial-menu interval129.1–129.7 and sustained wall/repair closeup after130.8.

game-master.publicPublishingCheck: Confirm exact recorder CC BY license URL and all description attribution before a separate publishing request.
